milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate to the light blue carpet trail and look at it. Target is the trail midpoint at spawn-relative (5, 0, 5), which is ~7.07 blocks from spawn. With max_distance=3, the player cannot trigger this from spawn and must actually walk to the carpet trail. facing_tolerance=45 ensures the player is looking toward the carpet blocks, modeling 'player has found and is observing the carpet'.

Uses count_in_box_at_most (kind='block') because glass panes drop nothing without Silk Touch enchantment, making inventory_has unusable. There is no mine_block rule type available. Instead, we verify the block was removed: initially 2 magenta_stained_glass_pane blocks exist at positions (9,2,8) and (11,2,8). Mining at least one reduces the count to at most 1. The generous box [7,1,6] to [13,3,14] fully encloses the building where the panes are placed, with no other magenta glass panes in the scene.
